{{nihongo|'''Atsushi Momose'''|百生敦|Momose Atsushi}} is a Japanese [[physicist]] and professor at [[Tohoku University]] known for his contributions to the field of [[phase-contrast X-ray imaging]].

==Biography==
Born in 1962 in [[Toyama Prefecture]], Momose graduated with a Master's degree in Engineering from [[The University of Tokyo]] in 1987. Between 1987 and 1999, he worked at the [[Hitachi]]'s Advanced Research Laboratory. During this time he completed his doctoral degree. 1997-1998 he worked one year at the synchrotron facility [[European Synchrotron Radiation Facility|ESRF]] in [[Grenoble]], [[France]]. In 1999, he was appointed associate professor at the department of applied physics at The University of Tokyo. In 2003, he was appointed associate professor at the Graduate School of Frontier Science. In 2012, he was appointed full professor at [[Tohoku University]] in [[Sendai]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tagen.tohoku.ac.jp/general/publish/forefront/ebook_03/HTML5/PC/Main.html |title=Tagen Forefront 03 |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website=Institute of Multidisciplinary Research for Advanced Materials |publisher=Tohoku University |access-date=2022-02-12}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://mml.tagen.tohoku.ac.jp/momose_e.html |title=Professor Momose |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website=Institute of Multidisciplinary Research for Advanced Materials |publisher= |access-date=2022-02-12}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://researchmap.jp/7000002207 |title=Atsushi Momose |author=<!--Not stated--> |date= |website=Researchmap |publisher= |access-date=2022-02-12}}</ref>

==Research==
Momose is mainly known for his work on [[Phase-contrast X-ray imaging#Grating-based imaging|grating-based phase-contrast X-ray imaging]]. He was the first to show that this could be accomplish in a [[Talbot effect|Talbot]] setup with two gratings and a detector.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Momose |first1=Atsushi |last2=Kawamoto |first2=Shinya |last3=Koyama |first3=Ichiro|last4=Hamaishi |first4=Yoshitaka |last5=Takai |first5=Kengo |last6=Suzuki |first6=Yoshio |date=2003 |title=Demonstration of X-Ray Talbot Interferometry |url=https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1143/JJAP.42.L866/meta |journal=Japanese Journal of Applied Physics |volume=42 |issue=7B |pages=L866 |doi=10.1143/JJAP.42.L866 |access-date=2022-02-12|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref name=AIP>{{cite journal |last1=Pfeiffer |first1=Franz |date=2012 |title=Milestones and basic principles of grating-based x-ray and neutron phase-contrast imaging |url=https://aip.scitation.org/doi/abs/10.1063/1.4742261 |journal=AIP Conference Proceedings |volume=1466 |issue= |pages=2 |doi=10.1063/1.4742261 |access-date=2022-02-12|url-access=subscription }}</ref> He was also one of the first to show grating-based imaging in combination with tomography.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Momose |first1=Atsushi |date=2005 |title=Recent Advances in X-ray Phase Imaging |url=https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1143/JJAP.44.6355/meta |journal=Japanese Journal of Applied Physics |volume=44 |issue=9R |pages=6355 |doi=10.1143/JJAP.44.6355 |access-date=2022-02-12|doi-access=free }}</ref>{{r|AIP}}

==Awards==
